snippet.title: SILENT STEEL (PC Windows) (1995) - Longplay [AVI Version] (uncommented)
snippet.description:
SILENT STEEL is a full motion video adventure by Tsunami Media. It was originally released in 1995 on 4 CD-ROMs for PC Windows 3.1. In the game, you are the captain of a US nuclear submarine on a routine peace-time patrol. However, when a hostile submarine appears in your waters out of nowhere, you must make clever decisions to uncover a devilish enemy plan and save your crew.

At specific points in the game, the plot stops for the player to decide the further progress of the story by selecting a possible action from a multiple choice menu. Taking wrong decisions might lead to your immediate death. The game has multiple good endings but the outcome of the story remains the same in all of them. You basically just get different celebration scenes.

This longplay shows the AVI version of the game running under Windows 3.1. SILENT STEEL was also released as MPEG version for Windows and later for DVD players (with a much better video quality obviously).
